correctness.rationale: Every source hypothesis is checked exactly. The direct-sum operator U is a norm-one partial isometry with closed range; K=U commutes; R(K*) and N(U*) meet trivially; the one-point family Lambda=K* is Parseval relative to K; yet the transformed lower ratio on e_n is lambda_n^2 and tends to zero. The universal repair follows from the identity K*U*=U*K* and necessity is certified by the test family Lambda=K*. The stronger range inclusion R(K*) subset R(U) restores the paper's pseudoinverse estimate.
